item.title: Lee Seok-yeon: "Orders to the military, regardless of who gives them, are only legitimate within the Constitution" (이석연 “軍에 대한 명령, 누구인가 불문하고 헌법 내에서만 정당”)
item.description:
Lee Seok-yeon: "Orders to the military, regardless of who gives them, are only legitimate within the Constitution" (이석연 “軍에 대한 명령, 누구인가 불문하고 헌법 내에서만 정당”)

Lee Seok-yeon, chair of the Presidential Committee on National Integration, stated on the 27th, "Orders to the military, regardless of who gives them, are only legitimate within the bounds of the Constitution, and any orders or directives that exceed the constitutional framework are unconstitutional and invalid." (대통령직속 국민통합위원회 이석연 위원장은 27일 “군에 대한 명령은 그 명령의 주체가 누구인가를 불문하고 헌법의 범위 내에서만 정당하며, 헌법의 테두리를 벗어난 명령이나 지시는 위헌이자 무효”라고 했다.)

Chairman Lee made these remarks during a visit to the 5th Infantry Division, where he served as a political warfare officer 44 years ago, taking on the role of a 'one-day political warfare officer' to conduct training for troops on the theme of 'Military mental strength based on constitutional values.' (이 위원장은 이날 자신이 44년 전 정훈장교로 복무했던 제5보병사단을 방문해 ‘1일 정훈장교’로 나서서 장병들을 대상으로 ‘헌법적 가치에 기반한 군 정신전력’을 주제로 정훈교육을 실시하며 이같이 밝혔다.)

Chairman Lee Seok-yeon emphasized, "The military is not a group that wields force, but a constitutional institution that carries out the sacred duties of national security and territorial defense. Mental strength is the will to fight in order to uphold constitutional values, and the military is the last bastion of constitutional protection." (이석연 위원장은 “군은 무력을 행사하는 집단이 아니라 국가안전보장과 국토방위의 신성한 의무를 수행하는 헌법기관”이라며 “정신전력은 헌법적 가치를 지키기 위한 전투의지로서, 군은 헌법 수호의 최후 보루”라고 했다.)

He continued, "Maintaining pride as democratic citizens in uniform, taking pride in being trusted by the people, and doing one's best in assigned duties with a military spirit and military action is the way to protect the nation and uphold the Constitution. The foundation of national integration must be further solidified based on trust between the military and the people." (이어 “군복 입은 민주시민으로서의 자부심을 견지하고, 국민에게 신뢰받는 존재로서 자긍심을 갖고 맡은 바 임무에 최선을 다하는 군인정신, 군사적 행동이야말로 국가를 수호하고 헌법을 지키는 길”이라며 “군과 국민 간 신뢰를 바탕으로 국민통합의 기반을 더욱 공고히 해야 한다”고 했다.)

This visit was organized to encourage the dedication of front-line troops amid ongoing uncertainties in the security environment and to reaffirm the military's role based on democratic and constitutional values. On this day, the 5th Infantry Division (Key Unit) selected Chairman Lee Seok-yeon as a 'Proud Key Person.' <<>> (이번 방문은 최근 안보 환경의 불확실성이 지속되는 가운데 전방 장병들의 헌신을 격려하고, 민주주의와 헌법 가치에 기반한 군의 역할을 재확인하기 위해 마련됐다. 이날 제5보병사단(열쇠부대)은 이석연 위원장을 ‘자랑스러운 열쇠인’으로 선정했다.)

item.title: Park: "Greater Leap for Gyeongnam Based on Four-Year Achievements" vs. Kim: "Immediate Restoration of the Busan-Ulsan-Gyeongnam Megacity" (朴 “4년 성과 바탕 경남 대도약” VS 金 “부울경 메가시티 즉각 복원”)
item.description:
Park: "Greater Leap for Gyeongnam Based on Four-Year Achievements" vs. Kim: "Immediate Restoration of the Busan-Ulsan-Gyeongnam Megacity" (朴 “4년 성과 바탕 경남 대도약” VS 金 “부울경 메가시티 즉각 복원” )

Gyeongnam Governor Park Wan-soo registered as a preliminary candidate on the 27th, challenging for re-election. Candidate Park described this election as "a choice between whether Gyeongnam leaps forward or regresses again." On the same day, Democratic Party candidate Kim Kyoung-soo proposed connecting public transportation networks to create a "30-minute living zone for the Busan-Ulsan-Gyeongnam Megacity" as his first pledge. (박완수 경남도지사가 재선에 도전하며 27일 예비후보로 등록했다. 박 후보는 이번 선거를 “경남이 도약하느냐, 다시 후퇴하느냐의 선택”이라고 했다. 같은 날 더불어민주당 김경수 후보는 대중교통망 연결을 통한 ‘부울경 메가시티 30분 생활권’을 제1호 공약으로 제시했다.)

Candidate Park personally visited the Gyeongnam Provincial Election Commission at 10 a.m. that day to complete the registration process as a preliminary candidate for the People Power Party's Gyeongnam governor race. Park had delayed his preliminary candidate registration, focusing instead on processing supplementary budget proposals, including the 328.8 billion won in resident livelihood support funds, and preparing for the 2026 National Sports Festival for Daily Life, which involved over 20,000 participants from 17 cities and provinces nationwide. (박 후보는 이날 오전 10시 경남도선거관리위원회를 직접 찾아 국민의힘 경남지사 예비후보 등록 절차를 마쳤다. 그동안 박 후보는 도민생활지원금 예산 3288억원을 포함한 추경안 처리, 전국 17개 시·도에서 2만여 명이 참가한 2026 전국생활체육대축전 준비 등에 주력하며 예비후보 등록을 늦춰왔다.)

With the governor's duties temporarily suspended from this day, Gyeongnam provincial administration will be run under an acting governor system led by Vice Governor for Administration Park Il-woong until midnight on June 3. (이날 도지사 직무가 일시 정지됨에 따라 오는 6월 3일 24시까지 경남도정은 박일웅 행정부지사의 도지사 권한대행 체제로 운영된다.)

Candidate Park emphasized to the press that this election is about choosing a local public servant. (박 후보는 취재진 앞에서 이번 선거를 지역 일꾼을 뽑는 선거라고 강조했다.)

He said, "Since the advent of local elections, past Gyeongnam governors have resigned for political reasons or been indicted and left office mid-term, causing great disruption to provincial administration. Over the past four years, I have managed the province without hesitation, ensuring Gyeongnam's continuous development in all areas, including the economy, population, and residents' living conditions." (그는 “민선 이후 과거 경남지사들이 정치적 목적으로 사퇴하거나 재판에 회부돼 중도 퇴직하면서 도정이 굉장히 흐트러졌다”며 “저는 지난 4년간 좌고우면하지 않고 도정을 챙겨 경제, 인구, 도민 생활 여건 등 모든 부분에서 경남이 지속 발전해 왔다”고 말했다.)

He added, "A political governor or one prioritizing personal interests should not again disrupt provincial administration. With a commitment to serve the residents, I will take charge of the province for another four years and build a solid foundation for Gyeongnam's great leap forward." (이어 “또다시 정치인 도지사, 개인 이익을 앞세우는 도지사가 도정을 흩트려서는 안 된다”며 “도민에게 헌신하겠다는 약속과 함께 4년 더 도정을 맡아 경남 대도약의 탄탄한 기반을 만들겠다”고 말했다.)

After completing his preliminary candidate registration, Candidate Park's first schedule was to pay respects at the National March 15 Democratic Cemetery and hold a press conference for his candidacy. Park said, "66 years ago, Gyeongnam was the first place in South Korea to rise up unarmed against a rigged election that distorted public sentiment. But today, laws that should be universal are arbitrarily changed to benefit the powerful, and judges and rulings are attacked when unfavorable. The rule of law, principles, and common sense have collapsed, and the shadow of one-party dictatorship looms large." (예비 후보 등록을 마친 박 후보는 첫 일정으로 국립 3·15 민주 묘지를 참배하고, 출마 기자회견을 가졌다. 박 후보는 “66년 전 경남은 민심을 왜곡하는 부정선거 앞에 대한민국 최초로 맨몸으로 일어선 곳”이라며 “그런데 오늘날 보편적이어야 할 법도 힘 있는 쪽이 마음대로 유리하게 바꾸고, 법관과 판결도 불리하면 공격하는 세상이 됐다. 법치와 원칙, 상식이 무너지고 1당 독재의 그림자가 짙게 드리우고 있다”고 했다.)

He continued, "The results of a one-party dictatorship era where checks and balances have disappeared, combined with digital opinion manipulation, are terrifying even to imagine. I will continue provincial administration by inheriting the spirit of March 15, which stood against illegal elections." Park's reference to "digital opinion manipulation" is interpreted as targeting Candidate Kim, who lost his governor post mid-term due to a conviction in the 2021 "Druking case" and was later granted a special pardon and restoration of rights under the Yoon Suk-yeol administration. (이어 “견제와 균형이 사라진 1당 독재 시대의 도래와 디지털 여론 조작이 결합하면 어떤 세상이 펼쳐질지 결과는 상상하기조차 두렵다”며 “불법 선거에 항거한 3·15 정신 계승으로 도정을 이어가겠다”고 했다. 박 후보가 지적한 ‘디지털 여론 조작’은 2021년 ‘드루킹 사건’으로 유죄가 확정돼 임기 중 지사직을 잃은 김 후보 측을 겨냥한 것으로 풀이된다. 김 후보는 윤석열 정부 때 특별사면·복권됐다.)

Immediately after his candidacy press conference, Candidate Park visited the grave of former President Roh Moo-hyun in Bongha Village, Jinyeong-eup, Gimhae. He wrote in the guestbook, "I will work hard for Gyeongnam by carrying forward the spirit of national unity, the rule of law and common sense, and consideration for the socially disadvantaged that you practiced in your lifetime." (박 후보는 출마 기자회견 직후 김해시 진영읍 봉하마을 노무현 전 대통령 묘역을 찾아 참배했다. 방명록에는 ‘생전에 실천하셨던 국민 통합의 정신, 법치와 상식, 사회적 약자에 대한 배려를 이어받아 경남을 위해 힘쓰겠습니다’라고 적었다.)

Democratic Party Candidate Kim visited the Gyeongnam Provincial Council that day to present his first pledge. The goal is to establish the Busan-Ulsan-Gyeongnam Megacity as a 30-minute living zone centered on four major railway networks. (더불어민주당 김 후보는 이날 경남도의회를 찾아 1호 공약을 제시했다. 4대 철도망 중심으로 부울경 메가시티를 30분 생활권으로 구축하겠다는 것이다.)

Candidate Kim said, "The first task for innovating Gyeongnam's economy is the immediate restoration of the Busan-Ulsan-Gyeongnam Megacity. Gyeongnam alone cannot overcome the single-centered structure of the Seoul Capital Area; we must bind the entire Busan-Ulsan-Gyeongnam region into one massive economic zone to create a 'second capital area.'" (김 후보는 “경남 경제 혁신을 위한 첫 번째 과제가 ‘부울경 메가시티’ 즉각 복원”이라며 “경남 혼자 힘으로는 수도권 일극 체제를 극복할 수 없고, 부울경 전체를 하나의 거대 경제권으로 묶어 ‘제2의 수도권’을 만들어야 한다”고 했다.)

He stated, "Enabling travel to anywhere in Busan, Ulsan, or Gyeongnam via public transit, just like in the Seoul Capital Area, is the minimum condition for making Gyeongnam a place where young people stay," and promised to build "four major metropolitan railway networks." (그는 “부울경 어디든 대중교통으로 수도권처럼 다닐 수 있게 해주는 것이 청년이 머무는 경남으로 가기 위한 최소한의 조건”이라며 ‘4대 광역 철도망’ 구축을 약속했다.)

Candidate Kim proposed advancing the completion of the Western Gyeongnam KTX, scheduled for 2031, by one year and extending the line from its terminus in Geoje to Gadeok-do New Airport. He also suggested high-speed KTX service from Dongdaegu to Changwon Masan, a South Coast metropolitan express railway connecting Jinju, Changwon, Gimhae, and Busan, and the early groundbreaking of the Moonlight Railway to link the northwestern part of Gyeongnam. (김 후보는 2031년 완공 예정인 서부경남 KTX의 완공 시기를 1년 앞당기고, 종착역인 거제에서 가덕도 신공항까지 노선 연장을 제시했다. 또 동대구에서 창원 마산으로 오는 KTX 고속화, 진주~창원~김해~부산을 잇는 남해안권 광역급행철도, 경남 서북권을 이을 달빛철도 조기 착공도 제안했다.)

He said he would secure the budget for building the four major metropolitan railway networks through securing national funds, private investment, and establishing the Busan-Ulsan-Gyeongnam Metropolitan Transportation Authority. (그는 국비 확보, 민자유치, 부울경광역교통공사 설립 등을 통해 4대 광역 철도망 구축 예산을 확보하겠다고 했다.)

On the same day, Candidate Kim also unveiled pledges for AI-based transportation innovation and resident-centered transportation welfare policies. He proposed eliminating public transit blind spots through an AI-based responsive public transportation platform with a call system for flexibly dispatching buses and taxis. He also presented plans to reduce residents' transportation costs, such as a "Gyeongnam Pass" offering unlimited use of all public transit at a fixed monthly rate. (김 후보는 이날 인공지능(AI) 기반 교통 혁신과 생활 밀착형 교통 복지 정책 공약도 공개했다. 버스·택시를 탄력적으로 배차하는 호출 시스템을 갖춘 AI 기반 이용자 반응형 대중교통 플랫폼을 통해 대중교통 사각지대를 없애겠다는 것이다. 매월 정액제로 모든 대중교통을 자유롭게 이용하는 ‘경남패스’ 등 도민 교통비 부담 완화 계획도 제시했다.)

Candidate Kim said, "Cities must be connected for jobs, industries, and tourism to develop together." (김 후보는 “도시가 연결되어야 일자리, 산업, 관광이 함께 발전할 수 있다”고 했다.)

In response to People Power Party Candidate Park's characterization of the provincial administration under the 7th elected term (Kim's term) as a "failure," he retorted, "The scrapping of the megacity project, which involved 70 projects and a 35 trillion won budget, has led to the current negative economic situation." (이날 국민의힘 박 후보가 민선 7기 김 후보 때의 도정을 ‘실패’로 규정한 것에 대해 “70개 사업, 35조 예산이 붙어 있던 메가시티 사업을 백지화한 결과가 지금의 마이너스 경제로 이어졌다”고 맞받아쳤다.)

This is the first time since the introduction of local autonomy in 1995 that current and former Gyeongnam governors from both ruling and opposition parties have faced off. Additionally, Jeon Hee-young, a candidate from the Progressive Party and former head of the Korean Teachers and Education Workers Union, has also entered the race. She is the first female candidate to run for Gyeongnam governor. There is also a possibility of a merger between the Democratic Party and the Progressive Party. When asked about a potential merger with Progressive Party candidate Jeon, Candidate Kim suggested discussions were underway, saying, "Negotiations are proceeding through various channels." <<>> (1995년 민선 지방자치제 도입 후 여야 전현직 경남지사가 대결하는 것은 이번이 처음이다. 여기에 전교조 위원장 출신인 전희영 진보당 후보도 출마했다. 경남지사에 도전하는 첫 여성 후보다. 민주당과 진보당 간 단일화 성사 가능성도 있다. 김 후보는 이날 진보당 전 후보와의 단일화 여부에 대한 질문이 나오자 “다양한 경로로 협의가 진행 중”이라며 논의가 이뤄지고 있음을 시사했다.)

item.title: Reform Party’s Busan mayoral candidate Jung Yi-han hospitalized after being hit by coffee during campaign rally (개혁신당 정이한 부산시장 후보, 유세 중 커피 맞아 병원 이송)
item.description:
Reform Party’s Busan mayoral candidate Jung Yi-han hospitalized after being hit by coffee during campaign rally (개혁신당 정이한 부산시장 후보, 유세 중 커피 맞아 병원 이송)

Reform Party candidate Jung Yi-han (38), running in the June 3 local elections, was taken to the hospital on the 27th after being hit by a beverage thrown by a citizen and falling during a campaign rally. (6·3 지방선거에 출마하는 개혁신당 정이한(38) 후보가 27일 선거 유세 도중 시민이 뿌린 음료에 맞아 넘어지면서 병원으로 이송됐다.)

According to the Reform Party, Jung was struck by a beverage thrown by a passing vehicle driver around 8:05 a.m. that day while campaigning on the street near Setung Tower in Geumjeong-gu, Busan. At the time, Jung was standing on a traffic island safety zone between the road and a flower bed when a driver allegedly rolled down the window, said, “What kind of kid runs for mayor?” and then threw a liquid substance, identified as coffee. (개혁신당에 따르면 정 후보는 이날 오전 8시 5분쯤 부산 금정구 세정타워 인근에서 거리 유세 중 지나가던 차량 운전자가 뿌린 음료에 맞았다. 당시 정 후보는 차도와 화단 사이 교통섬 형태의 안전지대에 있었는데, 한 운전자가 창문을 열고 “어린 놈이 무슨 시장 출마냐”는 취지로 말한 뒤 액체류 이물질을 던진 것으로 알려졌다. 이 액체는 커피로 파악됐다.)

Jung reportedly lost consciousness after falling backward in surprise from the thrown liquid. He was taken to a hospital in Busanjin-gu, regained consciousness, and underwent an MRI scan. (정 후보는 날아든 액체에 놀라 뒤로 넘어지면서 의식을 잃었던 것으로 전해진다. 부산진구의 병원으로 이송된 정 후보는 의식을 되찾은 뒤 자기공명영상(MRI) 검사를 받았다.)

The campaign committee reported the incident to 112 immediately after it occurred. Police are tracking the fleeing vehicle based on CCTV footage and investigating the exact circumstances of the case. (선대위 측은 사건 직후 112에 신고했다. 경찰은 CCTV 영상 등을 토대로 도주한 차량을 쫓는 한편 정확한 사건 경위를 조사하고 있다.)

The Reform Party issued a statement criticizing the act, saying, “Elections are a process of competition through ideas and policies. Violence should never be allowed for any reason, and attempts to resolve political differences through physical force are a line that our society must never cross.” (개혁신당은 입장문을 내고 “선거는 생각과 정책으로 경쟁하는 과정”이라며 “폭력은 그 어떤 이유로도 있어서는 안 되며 정치적 의견 차이를 물리력으로 해결하려는 시도는 우리 사회가 결코 용납해서는 안 될 선을 넘은 행위”라고 비판했다.)

item.title: Korea-Australia Foreign Ministers’ Meeting on the 30th: Discussions on Energy and Defense Industries (한·호주 30일 외교장관 회담…에너지·방산 등 논의)
item.description:
Korea-Australia Foreign Ministers’ Meeting on the 30th: Discussions on Energy and Defense Industries (한·호주 30일 외교장관 회담…에너지·방산 등 논의)

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced on the 27th that Foreign Minister Cho Hyun will meet with Australian Foreign Minister Penny Wong to discuss bilateral cooperation. (조현 외교부 장관과 페니 웡 호주 외교장관이 만나 양국 협력을 논의한다고 외교부가 27일 밝혔다.)

According to the Ministry, Minister Cho will hold a foreign ministers’ meeting with Minister Wong in Seoul on the afternoon of the 30th, where they plan to consult on key bilateral issues and mutual interests, including high-level exchanges, economic security, national defense and defense industries, and regional situations. (외교부에 따르면 조 장관은 오는 30일 오후 서울에서 웡 장관과 외교장관 회담을 열고 고위급 교류, 경제안보, 국방·방산, 지역 정세 등 양국 주요 현안 및 공동 관심사에 대해 협의할 예정이다.)

This meeting takes place about a month after the two ministers spoke by phone on the 16th of last month. During that call, they discussed issues such as energy matters stemming from the situation in the Middle East. (이번 회담은 두 장관이 지난달 16일 통화한 이후 한 달여 만에 개최되는 것이다. 당시 통화에서 양측은 중동 상황에 따른 에너지 문제 등을 논의했다.)

The Ministry stated that in this meeting, they “plan to reaffirm their willingness to cooperate in addressing common challenges such as the recent Middle East situation and the energy security crisis, and will also discuss in depth ways to deepen collaboration in areas like national defense and defense industries.” (외교부는 이번 회담에서 “최근 중동 상황 및 에너지 안보 위기 등 공동의 도전과제 대응을 위한 협력 의지를 재확인하고, 국방·방산 등 여타 분야에서의 협력 심화 방안에 대해서도 폭넓게 논의할 예정”이라고 했다.)

The Australian Embassy in Seoul announced that Minister Wong will visit Japan, China, and South Korea in succession this week as part of “efforts to strengthen foreign relations and shared energy security.” (주한호주대사관은 웡 장관이 “대외 관계 및 공동의 에너지 안보 강화를 위한 노력”의 일환으로 이번 주 일본, 중국, 한국을 차례로 방문한다고 밝혔다.)

The Embassy noted, “South Korea is an important supplier of refined petroleum products such as diesel, gasoline, and aviation fuel to Australia,” adding, “Australia will work with partners worldwide to secure necessary supplies like diesel, gasoline, and fertilizers, and to ensure that Australia is prioritized as a reliable energy partner.” (대사관은 “한국은 호주의 중요한 디젤, 휘발유, 항공유 등 정유 제품 공급국”이라며 “호주는 디젤, 휘발유, 비료 등 필요한 공급 물자를 확보하고 신뢰할 수 있는 에너지 파트너로서 호주가 우선적으로 고려될 수 있도록 전 세계 파트너와 협력할 것”이라고 했다.)

Minister Wong also visited South Korea last October for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Gyeongju, where she held talks with Minister Cho. (웡 장관은 지난해 10월 경주 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의 때도 방한해 조 장관과 회담을 했다.)

item.title: Lee: "Middle East War Anxiety Must Not Spread to the Korean Peninsula... We Must Live Without Fear of War" (李 “중동 전쟁 불안, 한반도로 전이돼선 안 돼... 전쟁 걱정없이 살아야”)
item.description:
Lee: "Middle East War Anxiety Must Not Spread to the Korean Peninsula... We Must Live Without Fear of War" (李 “중동 전쟁 불안, 한반도로 전이돼선 안 돼... 전쟁 걱정없이 살아야”)

President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 27th, "We must ensure that the uncertainty and anxiety in international affairs caused by the Middle East war do not spread to the Korean Peninsula, and create a path where all members of the Korean Peninsula can live without fear of war." (이재명 대통령은 27일 “중동전쟁으로 인한 국제정세의 불확실성과 불안이 한반도로 전이되지 않고, 한반도 모든 구성원들이 전쟁 걱정 없이 살 수 있는 길을 만들어 내야 한다”고 밝혔다.)

President Lee made this remark during a commemorative speech for the 8th anniversary of the April 27 Panmunjom Declaration, delivered on his behalf by Chief Political Secretary Hong Ik-pyo at the main conference hall of the National Assembly Members' Office Building in Yeouido, Seoul, that afternoon. He added, "Ending war, establishing a permanent peace regime, and achieving coexistence and prosperity between the two Koreas are the core spirit of the Panmunjom Declaration and the future we must inevitably pursue." (이 대통령은 이날 오후 4·27 판문점 선언 8주년을 맞아 서울 여의도 국회의원회관 대회의실에서 홍익표 청와대 정무수석이 대독한 기념식 축사를 통해 이같이 밝혔다. 그러면서 “전쟁 종식과 항구적 평화체제, 남북의 공존과 번영은 ‘판문점선언’의 핵심 정신이자, 우리가 반드시 가야 할 미래”라고 했다.)

President Lee said, "The future of peace and prosperity has not yet arrived, and the path between the South and the North is blocked by a cold and towering wall of 'hostile two states.' Nevertheless, it is the fate of both Koreas to bloom flowers of peace on the land of severance and hostility. This is because war and confrontation lead not to coexistence but to mutual destruction." (이 대통령은 “평화와 번영의 미래는 아직 오지 못했고, 남과 북 사이는 ‘적대적 두 국가’라는 차갑고 높다란 벽에 막혀 있다”며 “그럼에도 불구하고, 단절과 적대의 땅에 평화의 꽃을 피워야 하는 것은 남북 모두의 숙명이다. 전쟁과 대결은 공존이 아닌 공멸이기 때문”이라고 했다.)

President Lee stated, "Since its inception, the people's sovereignty government has made peaceful coexistence on the Korean Peninsula its top policy goal. We have clearly stated the principles of respecting the North's system, not pursuing absorption unification, and refraining from any hostile acts." He continued, "Our government will unwaveringly push forward the 'Korean Peninsula Peaceful Coexistence Policy.' We expect the North to trust the sincerity of our government and respond accordingly." (이 대통령은 “국민주권정부는 출범 이래 한반도의 평화적 공존을 최우선 정책목표로 삼았다”며 “북측의 체제를 존중하며, 흡수통일을 추구하지 않으며, 일체의 적대행위를 하지 않는다는 원칙도 분명히 밝혀 왔다”고 했다. 이어 “우리 정부는 ‘한반도 평화공존 정책’을 흔들림 없이 추진해 나갈 것”이라며 “북측도 우리 정부의 진정성을 믿고 호응해 오길 기대한다”고 했다.)

He added, "We expect the North to trust the sincerity of our government and respond accordingly. Even if winter is long, spring will eventually come. I firmly believe that if we build efforts toward peaceful coexistence and shared growth one by one, with the attitude of 'accumulating earth to make a mountain,' a full spring will return to the Korean Peninsula." <<>> (아울러 “북측도 우리 정부의 진정성을 믿고 호응해 오길 기대한다”며 “겨울이 길어도 끝내 봄은 온다. ‘적토성산(積土成山·흙을 쌓아 산을 만든다는 뜻)’의 자세로 평화공존과 공동성장을 향한 노력을 하나씩 쌓아간다면 완연한 봄이 한반도에 다시 찾아올 것이라 굳게 믿는다”고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Kim Young-hwan, Current Governor, Named People Power Party Candidate for North Chungcheong Province Governor (국민의힘 충북지사 후보에 김영환 현 지사)
item.description:
Kim Young-hwan, Current Governor, Named People Power Party Candidate for North Chungcheong Province Governor (국민의힘 충북지사 후보에 김영환 현 지사)

Kim Young-hwan, the incumbent governor of North Chungcheong Province, has been confirmed as the People Power Party’s candidate for the June 3 gubernatorial election. Initially cut off (excluded from nomination), Governor Kim saw the court’s temporary suspension of the decision upheld, allowing him to re-enter the primary and ultimately win. The governor, seeking re-election, will face Shin Yong-han, the Democratic Party candidate and former vice chairman of the Presidential Committee for Regional Development. (6·3 충북지사 국민의힘 후보로 김영환 현 충북지사가 확정됐다. 김 지사는 애초 컷오프(공천 배제)됐지만 법원에서 효력 정지 가처분이 인용되면서 다시 경선을 치르게 돼 최종 승리했다. 재선에 도전하는 김 지사는 지방시대위원회 부위원장 출신인 신용한 더불어민주당 후보와 맞붙는다.)

On the 27th, the People Power Party announced that in the North Chungcheong Province gubernatorial primary results, Governor Kim defeated lawyer Yoon Gap-geun to become the final candidate. The primary was conducted by combining 50% from votes of responsible party members and 50% from a general public opinion poll, held on the 25th and 26th. (국민의힘은 27일 충북지사 후보 경선 결과 김 지사가 윤갑근 변호사를 꺾고 최종 후보로 선출됐다고 밝혔다. 이번 경선은 지난 25~26일 책임당원 투표 50%와 일반 국민 여론조사 50%를 합산하는 방식으로 치러졌다.)

Immediately after being confirmed as the candidate, Governor Kim stated, “We are one under the name of the People Power Party. It is time for all of us to join forces for the true development of North Chungcheong Province and for victory in the general election.” He added, “I will compete confidently with policies and visions that enhance the province’s development and improve the quality of life for its residents.” (김 지사는 후보 확정 직후 “우리는 국민의힘이라는 이름 아래 하나다. 충북의 진정한 발전을 위해, 그리고 본선 승리를 위해 이제 모두 힘을 합쳐야 할 때”라며 “이번 선거를 충북 발전과 도민 삶의 질을 높일 정책과 비전으로 당당하게 승부하겠다”고 했다.)

Earlier, the People Power Party’s nomination management committee, prioritizing personnel renewal, had sought to replace incumbent regional government heads and cut off Governor Kim. However, on the 31st of last month, the court ruled that the nomination process “violated party rules” and upheld Governor Kim’s request for a temporary suspension of the decision. Subsequently, the People Power Party restarted the primary for the North Chungcheong Province gubernatorial candidate from scratch, and Governor Kim ultimately won after competing in the final primary against lawyer Yoon Gap-geun, who had defeated former National Police Agency Commissioner General Yoon Hee-keun. (앞서 국민의힘 공천관리위원회는 인적 쇄신을 앞세워 현역 광역단체장 물갈이에 나섰고 김 지사를 컷오프했었다. 하지만 법원은 지난달 31일 공천 과정을 두고 “당규를 어겼다”며 김 지사가 낸 효력 정지 가처분 신청을 인용했다. 이후 국민의힘은 충북 지사 후보 경선을 원점에서 다시 실시했고, 김 지사는 윤희근 전 경찰청장을 꺾고 올라온 윤갑근 변호사와 본경선을 벌여 최종 승리했다.)

Democratic Party candidate Shin Yong-han, who will face Governor Kim, was recruited by President Lee Jae-myung, then the Democratic Party leader, ahead of the 2024 general election. Shin served as the presidentially-appointed Youth Committee Chair under the Park Geun-hye administration, policy support director for former President Yoon Suk Yeol’s election campaign, and advisor to the presidential transition committee. He previously ran in the 2022 gubernatorial primary but withdrew and left the People Power Party. Shin was selected as the candidate after defeating Noh Young-min, former chief of staff to the Moon Jae-in administration, in the party’s primary. (김 지사와 맞붙는 민주당 신용한 후보는 2024년 총선을 앞두고 당시 민주당 대표였던 이재명 대통령이 영입한 인사다. 신 후보는 박근혜 정부 시절 대통령 직속 청년위원장, 윤석열 전 대통령 대선 캠프 정책총괄지원실장, 대통령직 인수위원회 자문위원 등을 맡았다. 2022년 충북지사 후보 경선에 나섰다가 불출마하고 국민의힘을 탈당했다. 신 후보는 이번 당내 경선에서 노영민 전 문재인 정부 대통령 비서실장을 꺾고 후보로 결정됐다.)

item.title: 30-Year-Old Arrested for Throwing Beverage at Busan Mayoral Candidate Jung Yi-han of Reform Party (정이한 개혁신당 부산시장 후보에 음료 투척한 30대 긴급체포)
item.description:
30-Year-Old Arrested for Throwing Beverage at Busan Mayoral Candidate Jung Yi-han of Reform Party (정이한 개혁신당 부산시장 후보에 음료 투척한 30대 긴급체포)

A driver who threw a beverage at Jung Yi-han, a candidate of the Reform Party running in the Busan mayoral election scheduled for June 3, has been apprehended by police. (오는 6월 3일 치러지는 부산시장 선거에 출마한 개혁신당 정이한 후보에게 음료수를 투척한 운전자가 경찰에 붙잡혔다.)

The Busan Metropolitan Police announced on the 27th that they have urgently arrested a man in his 30s, identified as A, on charges of violating the Public Official Election Act (obstruction of election freedom). (부산경찰청은 공직선거법 위반(선거자유방해) 혐의로 30대 남성 A씨를 긴급체포해 조사하고 있다고 27일 밝혔다.)

A is suspected of throwing a cup containing liquid at candidate Jung, who was campaigning on a road in Geumjeong-gu, Busan, around 8:05 a.m. on the same day. (A씨는 이날 오전 8시 5분쯤 부산 금정구 한 도로에서 운전을 하던 중 선거 유세를 하고 있던 정 후보를 향해 액체가 든 컵을 던진 혐의를 받고 있다.)

It has been reported that A shouted profanities and insults at candidate Jung, belittling the young politician, saying, "What right does a brat like you have to run for mayor?" (A씨는 정 후보에게 “어린놈의 XX가 무슨 시장 출마냐?”라며 청년 정치인을 비하하는 폭언과 욕설을 한 것으로 알려졌다.)

Investigations revealed that A is also in his 30s. Candidate Jung, born in 1988, is 38 years old. (A씨 자신도 30대인 것으로 조사됐다. 정 후보는 1988년생으로 38세다.)

Candidate Jung was hit in the face by the suddenly thrown beverage, lost his balance, and fell backward. Although campaign staff attempted to stop the fleeing vehicle, the driver escaped the scene. (정 후보는 갑작스럽게 날아온 음료수를 얼굴 등에 맞고 중심을 잃고 뒤로 넘어졌다. 후보 수행원들이 달아나는 가해 차량을 막으려 했지만, 운전자는 현장을 빠져나갔다.)

It has been reported that candidate Jung hit his head on the ground and lost consciousness before being taken to a hospital for treatment. He is now recovering. (정 후보는 머리를 땅바닥에 부딪쳐 의식을 잃은 상태에서 병원으로 옮겨져 치료받은 뒤 현재는 회복하고 있는 것으로 알려졌다.)

A police official stated, "We urgently arrested A around 2:20 p.m. today. We plan to investigate the motive behind the crime and whether there were any accomplices through questioning of the suspect." (경찰 관계자는 “이날 오후 2시 20분쯤 A씨를 긴급 체포했다”면서 “피의자에 대한 조사를 통해 범행 동기나 공모자 여부 등을 수사할 예정”이라고 밝혔다.)

Candidate Jung's camp said, "This beverage attack is a serious crime intended to block the challenge of a young politician and shake the foundations of democracy." (정 후보 측은 “이번 음료수 테러는 청년 정치인의 도전을 가로막고 민주주의 근간을 흔들려는 중대 범죄”라고 했다.)

item.title: Ha Jung-woo and Jeon Eun-su... Blue House Resignations and Election Bids... (하정우도 전은수도... 靑 줄사표, 출사표...)
item.description:
Ha Jung-woo and Jeon Eun-su... Blue House Resignations and Election Bids... (하정우도 전은수도... 靑 줄사표, 출사표...)

Ha Jung-woo, the Blue House's Senior Secretary for AI and Future Planning, expressed his intention to resign from the Blue House on the 27th. This comes just 10 months after he was appointed to the newly established position of Senior Secretary for AI and Future Planning when the current administration took office in June last year. Secretary Ha plans to run as the Democratic Party candidate in the by-election for the Busan Buk-gu Gap National Assembly seat, which became necessary after Democratic Party lawmaker Jeon Jae-soo was decided as the Busan mayoral candidate. <<> According to Blue House and ruling party sources, Secretary Ha expressed his intention to resign on this day. Secretary Ha attended a meeting schedule between President Lee Jae-myung and Demis Hassabis, co-founder and CEO of Google DeepMind, on the afternoon of the same day. It is expected that he will submit his resignation letter after this schedule and begin full-fledged election preparations. <<> Earlier, on the previous day (the 26th), Democratic Party leader Chung Cheong-rae stated that he had dinner with Secretary Ha and persuaded him to run in the by-election. In his opening remarks at an on-site supreme council meeting held in Anseong, Gyeonggi Province, Leader Chung met with Secretary Ha and urged him to run, saying, "The AI-perfect National Assembly member is you." He added, "I think (Secretary Ha) may have made his final decision overnight. I believe we will be able to deliver good news to all of you." <<> Secretary Ha, a native of Busan, earned his bachelor's, master's, and doctoral degrees in computer engineering from Seoul National University. He then served as the head of the AI Innovation Center and the head of the AI Lab at Naver before joining the current administration. President Lee was often seen praising Secretary Ha, calling him "HaGPT" during cabinet meetings and town hall meetings. <<> Secretary Ha is expected to face off against former Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Park Min-shik and former People Power Party leader Han Dong-hoon, who are preparing to run as the opposition candidates in Busan Buk-gu Gap. <<> Meanwhile, Blue House spokesperson Jeon Eun-su also reportedly expressed his intention to resign on this day. Spokesperson Jeon plans to run in the by-election for Asan-eul in South Chungcheong Province, which was the constituency of Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik. Since the chief of staff position cannot be held concurrently with a National Assembly seat, the position had remained vacant since Chief Kang was appointed in June last year. (하정우 청와대 AI미래기획수석이 27일 청와대 사의를 표명했다. 작년 6월 현 정부 출범과 함께 신설된 AI미래기획수석에 발탁된 지 10개월 만이다. 하 수석은 전재수 더불어민주당 의원이 부산시장 후보로 결정되면서 치러지게 된 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 민주당 후보로 출마할 예정이다.)

item.title: President Lee Meets 'Father of AlphaGo' – Meets Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis (李대통령 ‘알파고 아버지’ 만났다… 하사비스 구글 딥마인드 CEO 접견)
item.description:
President Lee Meets 'Father of AlphaGo' – Meets Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis (李대통령 ‘알파고 아버지’ 만났다… 하사비스 구글 딥마인드 CEO 접견)

President Lee Jae-myung met with Demis Hassabis, CEO of Google DeepMind and known as the 'father of AlphaGo,' on the 27th to discuss job issues and wealth redistribution in the context of AI technological advancements. During the meeting at the presidential office, President Lee stated, "There is a need for international regulatory norms or standards for the safe use of AI, but they seem to be quite lacking," according to a briefing by Kim Yong-beom, head of the policy office. (이재명 대통령이 ‘알파고의 아버지’ 데미스 허사비스 구글 딥마인드 최고경영자(CEO)를 27일 만나 AI 기술 발전에 따른 일자리 문제와 부의 재분배 등을 논의했다. 이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 허사비스 CEO를 접견한 자리에서 “AI를 안전하게 이용할 수 있는 국제 통제 규범이나 표준이 필요한데, 이게 매우 부족한 것 같다”고 말했다고 김용범 청와대 정책실장이 브리핑에서 전했다.)

This remark came after President Lee made a joking inquiry, saying, "I also use the Gemini program often, but sometimes it gives absurd answers—are those bugs?" CEO Hassabis replied, "I'm truly delighted and glad that you use Gemini," adding, "If the instructions aren't precise, it can veer in a different direction." (이런 언급은 이 대통령이 “제미나이 프로그램을 저도 자주 사용하는데, 그 제미나이가 가끔 엉뚱한 답을 내놓는다”며 “일종의 버그인 것이냐”고 농담 섞인 질문을 한 데서 비롯됐다. 허사비스 CEO는 “대통령님께서 제미나이를 사용하신다니 정말로 반갑고 기쁘게 생각한다”며 “지침이 정확하지 않으면 다른 방향으로 갈 수 있다”고 답했다.)

He further elaborated, "As AI becomes more powerful in the future, it will gain autonomy as 'AI agents' (AI assistants that perform tasks independently), and eventually, the era of Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) will arrive. At that point, we will need safety mechanisms we can control." He pointed out the risks of AI, such as malicious use and autonomous decision-making, stressing the need to create minimum 'guardrails' shared by the international community, including embedding security solutions from the design stage. (또 “앞으로 AI가 더 강력해지면 ‘AI 에이전트’(독립적으로 업무를 수행하는 AI 비서)로 자율성도 부여받고, 나아가 범용 인공지능(AGI) 시대가 도래한다”며 “그럴 때는 우리가 통제할 수 있는 안전장치들이 필요하다”고 부연했다. 그러면서 악의적 사용 가능성이나 독자적 의사결정 등 AI의 위험성을 지적하며 설계부터 보안 솔루션 탑재 등 국제사회가 공유할 최소한의 ‘가드레일’을 만들어야 한다고 답했다.)

In response, President Lee mentioned the necessity of international regulatory norms, and CEO Hassabis reportedly expressed agreement. Kim Yong-beom conveyed that CEO Hassabis said, "With intensifying private-sector competition and the deepening US-China tech rivalry, establishing international norms is not easy. There is an urgent need for countries like South Korea, the UK, and Singapore to collaborate, create a large framework, and leverage collective intelligence from both the public and private sectors to devise safety measures." (그러자 이 대통령이 국제적 통제규범의 필요성을 언급했고, 이에 허사비스 CEO도 공감을 표시했다고 한다. 허사비스 CEO는 “민간 부문의 경쟁이 심화하고 미·중 기술 경쟁이 심화하는 상황에서 국제 규범을 만드는 것이 쉽지 않다”며 “한국·영국·싱가포르 등이 협력해 큰 프레임워크를 만들고, 정부와 민간 부문이 집단 지성을 발휘해 안전장치를 마련하는 고민이 절실하다”고 말했다고 김 실장은 전했다.)

When President Lee asked, "I've been talking about basic income for over 20 years; isn't it now, in the AI era, that basic income is truly needed?" CEO Hassabis responded, "I agree with the necessity." He added, "We need to consider providing basic services such as housing, education, transportation, and health by the state, while also integrating principles from the capital market." (이 대통령이 “20여 년 전부터 기본소득을 얘기했는데, AI 시대인 지금이야말로 기본소득이 필요한 것 아니냐”고 묻자 허사비스 CEO는 “필요성에 동의한다”고 답변했다. 허사비스 CEO는 그러면서 “주택, 교육, 교통, 건강 등 기본적 서비스를 국가가 제공하되, 자본시장 원리도 접목하는 방안을 고민해야 한다”고 덧붙였다.)

Separately, Kim Yong-beom reported that Google plans to open a 'Google AI Campus' in Seoul within this year to significantly expand collaboration between researchers and startups. He particularly noted, "The Google AI Campus will open in Korea for the first time in the world, which carries considerable significance." The presidential office explained that this would be the first campus established outside DeepMind's home country, the UK. (한편 구글은 올해 안에 서울에 ‘구글 AI 캠퍼스’를 개소해 연구자 및 스타트업 간 협력을 본격적으로 확대하기로 했다고 김 실장은 전했다. 김 실장은 특히 “구글 AI 캠퍼스는 전 세계에서 처음으로 한국에 문을 열게 된 것으로, 그 의미가 적지 않다”고 소개했다. 이와 관련, 딥마인드가 본사 소재지인 영국을 제외하고 국외 지역에 설립하는 첫 캠퍼스라고 청와대 측은 설명했다.)

Discussions also included sending researchers to this campus. Kim Yong-beom stated, "We requested at least 10 personnel to be dispatched, and (CEO Hassabis) agreed on the spot." (이 캠퍼스에 연구진을 파견하는 방안도 논의됐다. 김 실장은 “최소 10명 정도 파견을 요청했고, (허사비스 CEO가) 즉석에서 동의했다”고 전했다.)

Earlier, as President Lee greeted CEO Hassabis in the reception room, he said, "Do you know that you are very famous among the people of South Korea?" adding, "Because a famous Korean Go player was defeated by AlphaGo, created by CEO Hassabis, the public was greatly shocked." This was a reference to the 'Match of the Century' between Go master Lee Sedol (9-dan) and the Go AI AlphaGo in 2016. CEO Hassabis replied, "Thank you for letting me know. I wasn't aware," and added, "It was an important match to win." (앞서 이 대통령은 허사비스 CEO를 접견실에서 맞이한 직후에는 “우리 대표님은 대한민국 국민에게 매우 유명하신 분인 거 아시냐”며 “허사비스 대표가 만든 알파고에 한국에서 바둑 기사로 유명한 분이 지는 바람에 국민들이 엄청난 충격을 받았다”고 인사를 건네기도 했다. 지난 2016년 벌어진 이세돌 9단과 바둑 AI 알파고가 벌인 ‘세기의 대국’을 언급한 것이다. 허사비스 CEO는 “알려주셔서 감사하다. (유명하다는 것을) 몰랐다”며 “중요한 대국을 이겼다”고 화답했다.)

He then remarked, "Seoul, where the AlphaGo match was held 10 years ago, became the birthplace of today's AI," and "Korea is a very special country to me and DeepMind." To commemorate the match, he presented President Lee with a special gift: a Go board signed by both himself and Lee Sedol. (그러면서 “10년 전 알파고의 대국이 열린 서울에서 오늘날의 AI가 태동했다”며 “한국은 나와 딥마인드에 매우 특별한 나라”라고 언급했다. 그는 10년 전 대국을 기념하는 특별 선물로 자신과 이 9단의 서명이 담긴 바둑판을 이 대통령에게 전달했다.)

item.title: 70 South Korean Lawmakers Send Counter-Letter in Response to US Coupang Protest Letter (與의원 70명 美 쿠팡 항의서한에 연명서한 맞불)
item.description:
70 South Korean Lawmakers Send Counter-Letter in Response to US Coupang Protest Letter (與의원 70명 美 쿠팡 항의서한에 연명서한 맞불)

<<>> It was reported on the 27th that Democratic Party of Korea lawmakers plan to send a collective protest letter to the U.S. Embassy in Seoul, in response to the U.S. government's protest to the South Korean government regarding the investigation and level of administrative sanctions over Coupang's personal information leak. This protest is in reaction to the U.S. government mentioning the "legal safety" of Coupang Inc. Chairman Kim Beom-seok and using it as leverage in security negotiations, suggesting that without resolution of the Coupang issue, consultations for implementing security agreements—such as South Korea's introduction of nuclear-powered submarines and securing uranium enrichment authority—would be difficult. ()

In a notice titled "Request for Signatures on a Protest Letter Against U.S. Judicial Sovereignty Infringement" sent to lawmakers on the same day, the Democratic Party's chief floor office stated, "Recently, the U.S. government demanded guarantees for the personal safety of Coupang's top leader, Kim Beom-seok, and even conveyed that it could halt high-level consultations if this demand is not accepted." They added, "This is an unprecedented case of linking the judicial risks of an individual corporate figure to intergovernmental negotiations, and it constitutes a clear infringement of judicial sovereignty." (미국 정부가 쿠팡의 개인정보 유출에 대한 수사와 행정제재 수위 등을 두고 우리 정부에 항의한 데 대해 더불어민주당 의원들이 주한미국대사관에 단체 항의 서한을 보낼 예정인 것으로 27일 전해졌다. 미 정부가 김범석 쿠팡Inc 의장의 ‘법적 안전’을 거론하면서 쿠팡 문제가 해결되지 않으면 한국의 원자력 추진 잠수함 도입, 우라늄 농축 권한 확보 등 안보 합의 이행을 위한 협의가 어렵다며 안보 협상의 지렛대로 삼은 데 대한 항의 차원이다.)

The notice further referenced a letter sent by 54 U.S. Republican lawmakers to South Korean Ambassador to the U.S., Kang Kyung-wha, claiming that "American companies are being systematically targeted, and Coupang is facing a government-wide attack," and demanding an immediate halt to "discriminatory regulation." The Democratic Party stated that this "goes beyond mere diplomatic conflict or disputes over sovereignty infringement and poses significant concerns of negatively impacting South Korea's labor rights and fair economic order." They added, "Accepting diplomatic protection demands for the head of a specific company while investigations and administrative actions against Coupang are ongoing could set a precedent where multinational corporations use diplomatic pressure to evade domestic judicial processes in the future." (민주당 원내수석실은 이날 의원들에게 보내는 ‘미국의 사법주권 침해 항의서한 연명 요청’이라는 공지에서 “최근 미국 정부가 쿠팡 총수 김범석의 신변 안전 보장을 요구하며 이를 수용하지 않을 경우 고위급 협의를 중단할 수 있다는 입장까지 전달했다”며 “이는 개별 기업인의 사법 리스크를 국가 간 협상과 결부시킨 전례 없는 사례로 명백한 사법주권 침해”라고 했다.)

A Democratic Party official said, "We view the expressions of opinion from the U.S. government and Republican lawmakers as excessive, and there is a consensus that we need to raise our voices as members of the legislature." On the same day, Democratic Party Senior Spokesperson Kang Joon-hyun also commented in a statement, "Should we have to change our law enforcement standards every time a foreign government says something?" and emphasized, "The issue is clear: determine whether there is legal wrongdoing and hold accountable according to the law and principles." Earlier, National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik also stated in a radio interview on the 24th, regarding the U.S. Republican lawmakers' protest letter, "Do not interfere in the domestic affairs of our country's legal measures." (이어 미국 공화당 소속 의원 54명이 강경화 주미대사에게 “미국 기업들이 조직적 표적이 되고 있다. 쿠팡에는 범정부적 공격을 가하고 있다”며 ‘차별적 규제’를 즉각 중단하라는 서한을 보낸 것을 거론하고 “단순한 외교 갈등이나 주권침해 논란에 그치지 않고 한국의 노동권과 공정경제 질서에 부정적 영향을 미칠 우려가 크다”고 했다. 이어 “쿠팡에 대한 수사와 행정조치가 진행 중인 상황에서 특정 기업 총수에 대한 외교적 보호 요구를 수용할 경우 향후 다국적 기업이 외교 압박을 통해 국내 사법을 회피하려는 선례로 이어질 것”이라고 했다.)

It has been reported that Democratic Party Deputy Floor Leader lawmaker Park Hong-bae and others collected signatures from approximately 70 Democratic Party lawmakers on a collective protest letter against the U.S. government on the same day. Park and his colleagues are reportedly planning to hold a press conference at the National Assembly on the morning of the 28th and then deliver the protest letter to the U.S. Embassy. A Democratic Party official said, "Additional lawmakers have expressed their intent to join after hearing about (the writing of the protest letter), so we may collect more signatures by tomorrow." (민주당 관계자는 “미국 정부와 의회 공화당 의원들의 의견 표명이 과도하다고 보고 입법부 구성원으로서 목소리를 내야한다는데 공감대를 형성했다”고 했다. 이날 강준현 민주당 수석대변인도 논평에서 “외국 정부가 몇 마디 한다고 해서, 그때마다 우리의 법 집행 기준을 바꿔야 하느냐”며 “쟁점은 분명하다. 위법 여부를 따지고, 법과 원칙에 따라 책임을 묻는 것”이라고 했다. 앞서 우원식 국회의장도 지난 24일 라디오 인터뷰에서 미국 공화당 의원의 항의 서한 발송에 대해 “우리나라 법률의 조치에 대해 내정 간섭하지 말라”고 했었다.)

item.title: North Jeolla Governor Kim Gwan-young to Appear Before Special Counsel for ‘12·3 Martial Law’ Probe… “Decision on Independent Run Next Week” (김관영 전북지사, ‘12·3 계엄’ 특검 출석… “무소속 출마, 다음 주 내 결론”)
item.description:
North Jeolla Governor Kim Gwan-young to Appear Before Special Counsel for ‘12·3 Martial Law’ Probe… “Decision on Independent Run Next Week” (김관영 전북지사, ‘12·3 계엄’ 특검 출석… “무소속 출마, 다음 주 내 결론”)

North Jeolla Province Governor Kim Gwan-young will appear before the second joint special counsel team on the 30th over allegations of aiding insurrection related to the ‘12·3 Martial Law’ incident. Regarding his potential run as an independent candidate—a topic that has surfaced since his expulsion from the Democratic Party of Korea amid the so-called ‘chauffeur expense distribution’ controversy—he stated he would announce an official position within next week. (김관영 전북특별자치도지사가 30일 ‘12·3 계엄’ 관련 내란 방조 의혹으로 2차 종합 특검팀에 출석한다. 이른바 ‘대리 운전비 살포’ 논란으로 더불어민주당에서 제명된 이후 불거진 무소속 출마 여부에 대해서는 다음 주 내로 공식 입장을 밝히겠다고 말했다.)

Governor Kim held a press conference at the North Jeolla Provincial Office on the 27th to explain his upcoming schedule and political stance. He said, “I have decided to attend at the request of the special counsel, who asked me to appear at 2 PM on the 30th of this month.” He added, “This is a matter concerning the honor of our provincial office public officials who worked to protect the residents during the December 3 martial law. I will explain all circumstances during the investigation to clear ourselves of disgrace.” (김 지사는 27일 전북도청에서 기자간담회를 열고 이 같은 향후 일정과 정치적 입장을 설명했다. 김 지사는 “이달 30일 오후 2시 출석해 달라는 특검의 요청에 따라 참석하기로 했다”고 밝혔다. 그는 “12·3 계엄 당시 도민을 지키기 위해 노력한 우리 도청 공직자들의 명예가 달린 일”이라며 “수사 과정에서 모든 경위를 설명해 불명예로부터 벗어나겠다”고 말했다.)

Kim expressed dissatisfaction with the Democratic Party’s disciplinary action. Regarding the ‘chauffeur fee payment’ that served as grounds for the punishment, he questioned the fairness of the discipline, noting, “The National Election Commission determined that it was unrelated to the election and did not even impose fines on the young politicians who received the chauffeur fees.” He also expressed regret over the disqualification of five young politicians from candidacy as a result. (민주당의 제명 조치에 대해서는 불만을 드러냈다. 김 지사는 징계 사유가 된 ‘대리기사비 교부’에 대해 “선관위는 선거와 연관이 없다고 판단해 대리기사비를 받은 청년 정치인들에게 과태료도 물리지 않았다”며 징계의 형평성 문제를 제기했다. 또한 이로 인해 청년 정치인 5명의 후보자 자격이 박탈된 점에 대해 유감을 표했다.)

He argued, “Even though Assemblyman Ahn Ho-young went on a 12-day hunger strike claiming unfairness in the ethics inspection process of other candidates, the party is trying to quietly sweep it under the rug without an official re-inspection.” He added, “There is widespread public opinion that we must sound an alarm against the unfair handling of affairs by the leadership under Jeong Cheong-rae and decision-making that disregards North Jeolla.” (그는 “다른 후보의 윤리 감찰 과정이 불공정하다며 안호영 의원이 12일간 단식까지 했음에도, 당은 공식적인 재감찰 없이 유야무야 덮으려 한다”며 “정청래 지도부의 불공정한 업무 처리와 전북을 무시하는 의사 결정에 경종을 울려야 한다는 여론이 많다”고 주장했다.)

Governor Kim, who has left open the possibility of running as an independent, indicated that a decision is imminent, saying, “April is a time for reflection and deliberation.” (무소속 출마 가능성을 열어둔 김 지사는 “4월은 성찰과 숙고의 시간”이라며 결정이 임박했음을 알렸다.)

He stated, “I am also hearing opinions that I should be cautious (about an independent run) considering future relations with the Democratic Party,” but added, “I am conflicted because I hold as my political philosophy the late former President Kim Dae-jung’s words: ‘If you think something is unjust, you must act on it.’” Considering factors such as the special counsel investigation schedule, Governor Kim said he would clearly state his position for or against running no later than next week. (그는 “향후 민주당과의 관계를 생각해 (무소속 출마에) 신중해야 한다는 의견도 듣고 있다”면서도, “고(故) 김대중 전 대통령의 ‘불의라고 생각하면 행동으로 옮겨야 한다’는 말씀을 정치 철학으로 삼고 있어 고민되는 지점”이라고 말했다. 김 지사는 특검 조사 일정 등을 고려해, 늦어도 다음 주까지는 출마에 대한 가부간의 입장을 명확히 밝히겠다고 했다.)

item.title: DP Excludes Kim Yong from Nominations... Lee Gwang-jae for Hanam-gap, Kim Yong-nam for Pyeongtaek-eul, Kim Nam-kuk for Ansan-gap (與, 김용 공천 배제…하남갑 이광재·평택을 김용남·안산갑 김남국)
item.description:
DP Excludes Kim Yong from Nominations... Lee Gwang-jae for Hanam-gap, Kim Yong-nam for Pyeongtaek-eul, Kim Nam-kuk for Ansan-gap (與, 김용 공천 배제…하남갑 이광재·평택을 김용남·안산갑 김남국)

On the 27th, the Democratic Party of Korea strategically nominated former Gangwon Governor Lee Gwang-jae for the by-election in Hanam-gap, Gyeonggi Province, former Saenuri Party lawmaker Kim Yong-nam for Pyeongtaek-eul, and spokesperson Kim Nam-kuk for Ansan-gap, all of which coincide with the June 3 local elections. Kim Yong, a close aide of President Lee Jae-myung and former deputy director of the Democratic Research Institute, who had been demanding nominations in Gyeonggi Province, was excluded from the candidate list. <<> Senior Democratic Party spokesperson Kang Jun-hyun told reporters after a closed-door Supreme Council meeting, "We decided to strategically nominate former Governor Lee for Hanam-gap, former lawmaker Kim for Pyeongtaek-eul, and spokesperson Kim for Ansan-gap." <<> Regarding former Governor Lee, who was assigned to Hanam-gap, Senior Spokesperson Kang stated, "He is a heavyweight politician who has served as a three-term lawmaker and a regional government head. He is the right person to swiftly resolve major regional national projects, such as the extension of the GTX, by directly connecting them with the central government." He added, "We judged him to be the most competitive candidate, possessing both experience winning in conservative strongholds and a high understanding of metropolitan area issues." <<> On former lawmaker Kim, who will run in Pyeongtaek-eul, Kang said, "He is a representative figure of rational and reformist conservatism," and "He contributed significantly to expanding the reach of our camp and securing victory during the last presidential election." Regarding spokesperson Kim, nominated for Ansan-gap, Kang noted, "He recently served as the Presidential Secretary for Digital Communication under the President's Office, gaining the deepest understanding of President Lee Jae-myung's governing philosophy and communicating with the public," and "Based on his solid organizational skills and high understanding of key issues, gained from his past tenure as a lawmaker representing the Ansan Danwon district, he will be immediately deployed to the field and lead our party to victory." <<> Former Deputy Director Kim Yong was excluded from the nominations. Secretary-General Jo Seung-rae said, "We judged that, considering the overall impact on the local elections and by-elections, it was appropriate not to nominate him," and added, "Reviewing his nomination for other regions is also difficult." item.title: Google to Establish AI Campus in Seoul Within This Year (구글, 연내 서울에 AI 캠퍼스 만든다)
item.description:
Google to Establish AI Campus in Seoul Within This Year (구글, 연내 서울에 AI 캠퍼스 만든다)

The presidential office announced on the 27th that Google has decided to open an AI (Artificial Intelligence) campus in South Korea this year. The AI campus will be a center where AI researchers dispatched by Google collaborate with domestic scholars and startups. The presidential office stated, "Google plans to dispatch about 10 personnel." (구글이 올해 한국에 AI(인공지능) 캠퍼스를 열기로 했다고 청와대가 27일 밝혔다. AI 캠퍼스는 구글이 파견한 AI 연구자와 국내 학자, 스타트업이 협업하는 센터다. 청와대는 “구글에서 10여명의 인력을 파견할 계획”이라고 했다.)

President Lee Jae-myung met with Demis Hassabis, CEO of Google DeepMind, at the presidential office on this day. CEO Hassabis led the development of AlphaGo, the Go AI, in 2016, and gained fame when AlphaGo defeated Korean Go master Lee Sedol in a match held in South Korea. (이재명 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 구글 딥마인드의 데미스 하사비스 대표를 접견했다. 하사비스 대표는 2016년 바둑 AI인 알파고 개발을 이끌었고, 알파고가 한국에서 이뤄진 이세돌 9단과의 대국에서 승리하면서 명성을 얻었다.)

When President Lee remarked, "The defeat of a Korean Go player by AlphaGo was a huge shock to the people," CEO Hassabis replied, "The AlphaGo match in Seoul 10 years ago marked the birth of today's AI. AlphaGo was the pioneering model for technology validation." (이 대통령이 “대한민국 바둑 기사가 알파고에 지는 바람에 국민들이 엄청난 충격을 받았다”고 하자, 하사비스 대표는 “10년 전 알파고 대국이 열린 서울에서 오늘날의 AI가 태동했다. 알파고는 기술 검증의 시초가 된 모델”이라고 했다.)

The two reportedly discussed plans for Google to open a "Google AI Campus" in Seoul within this year to support researchers and startups. Kim Yong-beom, the presidential office's policy chief who attended the meeting, said, "We requested CEO Hassabis to dispatch at least 10 Google researchers, and he agreed on the spot." (두 사람은 구글이 올해 안에 서울에 ‘구글 AI 캠퍼스’를 개소하고 연구자와 스타트업 지원에 나서는 방안을 논의했다고 한다. 배석한 김용범 청와대 정책실장은 “우리는 최소 10명 정도의 구글 연구진 파견을 하사비스 대표에게 요청했고, 하사비스 대표는 즉석에서 동의했다”고 전했다.)

The "Google AI Campus" is expected to be established in Gangnam, Seoul, with an area of approximately 600 pyeong (about 2,000 square meters). It will serve as a venue where Google DeepMind and domestic personnel carry out the "K-Moonshot Project." This initiative is a pan-governmental project aimed at solving national challenges by integrating AI and science and technology, with the goal of addressing national tasks in eight fields (advanced biotechnology, future energy, physical AI, space, materials, AI scientists, semiconductors, and quantum computing) by 2035. (‘구글 AI 캠퍼스’는 서울 강남에 600평 규모로 조성될 예정이다. 구글 딥마인드와 국내 인력들이 ‘K-문샷 프로젝트’를 수행하는 장소로 활용된다. 이 프로젝트는 AI와 과학기술을 융합해 국가적 난제를 해결하자는 취지로 만들어진 범정부 프로젝트로, 2035년까지 8대 분야(첨단바이오, 미래에너지, 피지컬AI, 우주, 소재, AI과학자, 반도체, 양자)의 국가 과제를 해결하는 게 목표다.)

CEO Hassabis stated, "The ultimate goal is to use AI as a tool for scientific discovery," adding, "It can create breakthroughs in areas like new material development and treatment of incurable diseases, ushering in a new golden age for humanity." CEO Hassabis also won the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for developing AlphaFold, an AI model for predicting protein structures. (하사비스 대표는 “AI를 과학적 발견의 도구로 활용하는 것이 궁극적인 목표”라며 “신소재 개발·난치병 치료 등에서 돌파구를 만들어낼 수 있고 인류가 새로운 황금기를 맞이할 수 있다”고 했다. 하사비스 대표는 AI를 이용한 단백질 구조 예측 모델인 알파폴드를 개발한 공로로 2024년 노벨화학상을 받기도 했다.)

item.title: US Satellite Intelligence for ‘Real-Time N. Korea Nuclear Tracking’ Not Shared with South Korea for a Month (美 ‘북핵 실시간 추적’ 위성 정보, 한달째 한국과 공유 안해)
item.description:
US Satellite Intelligence for ‘Real-Time N. Korea Nuclear Tracking’ Not Shared with South Korea for a Month (美 ‘북핵 실시간 추적’ 위성 정보, 한달째 한국과 공유 안해)

After Unification Minister Chung Dong-young pointed to ‘Kusong, North Pyongan Province’ as the location of a North Korean uranium enrichment facility—a site previously unacknowledged by both South Korea and the US governments—it was reported on the 27th that the US government had ceased sharing satellite intelligence on North Korean nuclear facilities, including Kusong, with the South Korean government. Although Minister Chung claimed the information was ‘based on publicly available sources,’ the US side appears to have judged it as a leak of its own classified intelligence and has subsequently restricted the provision of information from the same category. <<> Since the beginning of this month, the US government has limited the sharing of long-term technical intelligence related to North Korea’s nuclear and weapons of mass destruction (WMD) programs. It has been reported that intelligence on nuclear facilities in places like Kusong, captured by US reconnaissance satellites, has not been shared for a month. Concerns are rising that if this information-sharing restriction continues for an extended period, the intelligence gap between South Korea and the US will widen, potentially creating blind spots in South Korea’s surveillance network over North Korea. <<> Previously, Defense Minister An Kyu-back stated on the 22nd during a plenary session of the National Assembly’s Legislation and Judiciary Committee that the restrictions on intelligence sharing were “not significantly extensive.” In response, the Ministry of National Defense explained, “This was in the context of maintaining a robust readiness posture through close intelligence sharing amid North Korea’s successive missile launches.” In fact, it was reported that the US continues to share missile intelligence that directly impacts the South Korean military’s readiness posture, including information when North Korea tested ‘cluster munitions’ on short-range ballistic missiles on the 8th and 19th. <<> However, experts point out that satellite intelligence on nuclear facilities, which the US has restricted, is essential for real-time tracking of North Korea’s nuclear development status. It has been reported that the US has been tracking and observing various changes in North Korea’s nuclear complexes or suspected areas—such as reactors, uranium enrichment facilities, nuclear fuel rod production facilities, spent fuel rod storage sites, and plutonium production facilities—and sharing this intelligence with South Korea’s intelligence authorities. <<> After news of the US intelligence-sharing restrictions emerged, voices within the South Korean government suggested that ‘corresponding measures,’ such as limiting the sharing of South Korean intelligence, might be unavoidable. The South Korean military currently operates five military reconnaissance satellites. The military claims it can “monitor and reconnoiter specific targets within North Korea at intervals of two hours.” <<> However, with only five satellites, gaps inevitably occur between revisit intervals, making it difficult to track simultaneous activities across multiple locations. A military source stated, “With five reconnaissance satellites, it is virtually impossible to closely monitor the movements of North Korea, which possesses hundreds of transporter erector launchers (TELs).” <<> In contrast, the US operates over 240 military satellites and also has many civilian satellites in cooperative relationships with the US government. There are also differences in resolution. The resolution of South Korea’s satellites is at the level of 30 to 50 centimeters, meaning they can capture details of about 30 or 50 centimeters in length and width per pixel. US military reconnaissance satellites have a resolution of less than 10 centimeters, allowing them to see people and objects on the ground as clearly as if reading a palm. <<> Lee Il-woo, director of the Korea Defense Network, said, “Since information such as satellite orbits and revisit cycles is disclosed through the International Telecommunication Union (ITU), North Korea can know the revisit cycles of our satellites and conceal related activities. However, such deception is impossible against the US, which effectively enables real-time surveillance.” <<> National Security Office Director Chung Eui-yong stated on the 23rd that South Korea and the US are “trying to find some kind of way out.” Deputy Minister for Foreign Affairs Strategy and Intelligence Chung Youn-du met with US Deputy Secretary of State for Political Affairs Allison Hooker in Washington, DC on the 24th (local time) to discuss this issue. <<> However, a diplomatic and security source said, “The US position is quite firm,” adding, “It seems unlikely that the sharing of North Korea-related nuclear intelligence will resume quickly.” A former senior official at the Ministry of National Defense said, “Once a conflict between South Korea and the US surfaces, it’s not easy to resolve.” On the 27th, lawmakers from the People Power Party on the National Assembly Intelligence Committee held a plenary session to raise questions about the situation, but it was disrupted due to the absence of the Democratic Party and National Intelligence Service (NIS) Director Lee Jong-suk and other NIS officials. (정동영 통일부 장관이 북한의 우라늄 농축 시설 소재지로 이전에 한·미 정부가 인정한 적 없는 ‘평북 구성’을 지목한 후, 미국 정부가 우리 정부에 공유를 중단한 정보는 구성을 포함한 북한 핵 시설의 위성 정보 등인 것으로 27일 전해졌다. 정 장관은 ‘공개 자료를 사용한 설명’이라고 했지만, 미국 측은 자국이 수집한 기밀 정보의 누설로 판단해 같은 계통의 정보 제공을 제한한 것으로 볼 수 있다.)

item.title: Why Is a US Tank There?… North Korea Displays It in Exhibition Hall for Russian Deployment (美 탱크가 왜 거기서… 北, 러 파병 기념관에 전시)
item.description:
Why Is a US Tank There?… North Korea Displays It in Exhibition Hall for Russian Deployment (美 탱크가 왜 거기서… 北, 러 파병 기념관에 전시)

North Korea has been confirmed to have installed a memorial hall in Pyongyang for its deployment to Russia, displaying what appears to be a U.S. M1 Abrams tank captured during combat with Ukrainian forces. The Abrams tank is a main battle tank used by the U.S. military, including by U.S. forces stationed in South Korea, and in 2023, the Biden administration provided 31 of them to Ukraine. Experts believe North Korea, having secured the Abrams tank, may seek to identify vulnerabilities, disassemble the tank to understand its structure, and attempt "reverse engineering" to apply the findings to the design of its own tanks. <<> On the 27th, North Korea’s Korean Central News Agency reported that Chairman Kim Jong Un attended the completion ceremony of the "Memorial Hall for Overseas Military Operations Combat Training Feats" held in Pyongyang the previous day. The Russian military lost parts of the southwestern Kursk region to Ukrainian forces during their counteroffensive in 2024, but recaptured the area in April last year with the help of North Korean troops deployed there. To mark the first anniversary of the recapture, Russian Defense Minister Andrei Belousov and Russian State Duma Chairman Vyacheslav Volodin visited North Korea to attend the completion ceremony. <<> North Korea released photos showing Kim Jong Un touring the memorial hall with Russian officials, where Western tanks and armored vehicles presumed to have been captured on Ukrainian battlefields were displayed. In the photos released by North Korea, besides the U.S. main battle tank M1 Abrams, German Leopard 2A4 tanks and French AMX-10RC armored vehicles were also visible. A military official stated, "We believe it is highly likely these are trophies captured by Russia or North Korea." It is possible that Russian forces captured them and gifted them to North Korea, or that North Korean troops captured them themselves. <<> Shin Jong-woo, secretary general of the Korea Defense and Security Forum, said, "The armor of the Abrams tank is 'composite armor,' different from that of South Korean tanks, and there is a possibility that North Korea will examine this armor to identify vulnerabilities." Last month, Kim Jong Un visited a training base of the People's Army's Capital Defense Corps and boarded a new main battle tank personally operated by his daughter, Ju-ae. This tank was equipped with an "active defense system" that automatically reacts to and intercepts enemy anti-tank weapons, and there is a possibility that North Korea developed this new tank using captured Western tanks. (북한이 평양에 러시아 파병 기념관을 설치하고, 우크라이나군과의 전투 과정에서 노획한 것으로 보이는 미국의 M1 에이브럼스 전차를 전시한 것으로 확인됐다. 에이브럼스 전차는 주한미군도 쓰고 있는 미국의 주력 전차로, 2023년 당시 바이든 행정부가 우크라이나에 31대를 지원했다. 전문가들은 에이브럼스 전차를 확보한 북한이 취약점을 찾고, 전차를 분해해서 구조를 파악한 뒤 자국군 전차 설계에 이용하는 ‘역설계’ 등을 시도할 가능성이 있다고 보고 있다.)

item.title: ‘Attracted a 7 Trillion Won Data Center, Transforming Ulsan into the AI Capital’ (“7조 데이터센터 유치했다, 울산을 AI 수도로”)
item.description:
‘Attracted a 7 Trillion Won Data Center, Transforming Ulsan into the AI Capital’ (“7조 데이터센터 유치했다, 울산을 AI 수도로”)

Ulsan Mayor Kim Doo-gyeom stated, “I will transform Ulsan, the industrial capital that once fed South Korea with heavy chemical industries, into the ‘AI capital’.” Mayor Kim, who is seeking reelection as a candidate for the People Power Party, said, “Last year, we attracted a 7 trillion won, 103-megawatt (MW) AI data center from SK Broadband and Amazon Web Services (AWS), which is scheduled to begin operations by the end of next year. If I win reelection, my goal is to bring a 100 trillion won, 1-gigawatt (GW) AI data center to Ulsan.” (김두겸 울산시장은 “중화학 공업으로 대한민국을 먹여 살리던 산업 수도(首都) 울산을 ‘AI(인공지능) 수도’로 변모시키겠다”고 했다. 국민의힘 후보로 재선에 도전하는 김 시장은 “작년 SK브로드밴드·아마존웹서비스(AWS)의 7조원대 103메가와트(MW) 규모 AI 데이터센터를 유치했고, 내년 말 가동할 예정”이라며 “재선에 성공한다면 100조원대, 1기가와트(GW) 규모의 AI 데이터센터를 울산에 유치하는 게 목표”라고 했다.)

Currently, the Democratic Party of Korea has nominated lawmaker Kim Sang-wook, and the Progressive Party has nominated former lawmaker Kim Jong-hoon as candidates for Ulsan mayor, with discussions on a unified candidate underway. On the conservative side, former Ulsan Mayor Park Maeng-woo, who was excluded from the People Power Party’s nomination, has declared his independent candidacy. (현재 더불어민주당은 김상욱 의원, 진보당은 김종훈 전 의원을 울산시장 후보에 공천했고 단일화 논의가 진행 중이다. 반면 보수 쪽에선 국민의힘 공천에서 탈락한 박맹우 전 울산시장이 무소속 출마를 선언했다.)

Mayor Kim said, “(In this election) central party support is definitely not helpful for us,” adding, “We need to create a nationwide wave through a broad conservative grand coalition that embraces figures like former leader Han Dong-hoon.” He also suggested forming an election committee for the Yeongnam region composed of diverse individuals. The interview with Mayor Kim took place on the 22nd, followed by additional questions and answers via phone. (김 시장은 “(이번 선거에선) 중앙당 지원이 결코 우리에게 도움이 되지 않는 상황”이라며 “한동훈 전 대표 등을 품는 범보수 대통합으로 전국적인 바람을 일으켜야 한다”고 했다. 다양한 인물로 영남권 선거대책위원회를 구성하자는 의견도 제시했다. 김 시장과의 인터뷰는 지난 22일 이뤄졌고 이후 전화로 추가 문답이 진행됐다.)

- Why are you seeking reelection? (-재선에 도전하는 이유는.)

“For Ulsan to develop, it can no longer rely solely on the old heavy chemical industries. It must be reborn as an industrial city that integrates existing manufacturing industries with AI technology. The ‘Special Act on Revitalizing Distributed Energy,’ led by Ulsan, took effect in 2024, introducing a differential rate system that lowered energy costs. This enabled us to attract the 7 trillion won, 103MW AI data center last June. I want to expand this into a 100 trillion won, 1GW AI data center. We’ve also begun work on creating an underwater data center in Ulsan, the first in the nation, which can reduce cooling energy by 40% using natural underwater cooling.” (“울산이 발전하려면 더 이상 옛 중화학 위주 산업만으로는 안 된다. 기존 제조 산업과 AI 기술을 융합한 산업 도시로 거듭나야 한다. 울산이 주도한 ‘분산 에너지 활성화 특별법’이 2024년 시행돼 에너지 요금이 더 저렴해진 차등 요금제가 도입되면서, 작년 6월 7조원대 103MW 규모의 AI 데이터센터를 유치할 수 있었다. 이를 100조원대의 1GW 규모의 AI 데이터센터로 키우고 싶다. 전국 최초로 수중 자연 냉각으로 냉각 에너지 40%를 절감할 수 있는 해저 데이터센터를 울산에 만드는 작업도 들어갔다.”)

- Is there enough power supply? (-그만한 전력이 있나.)

“Near the AI data center, scheduled to operate by the end of next year, there is SK Multiutility’s liquefied natural gas (LNG) combined heat and power plant, ensuring a smooth power supply. With the operation of Shinul Units 3 and 4 nuclear reactors at the end of this year and next year, respectively, the electricity self-sufficiency rate will reach 238%. We are also promoting the construction of offshore wind power with companies from four countries, including Norway. If this goes well, the electricity self-sufficiency rate could rise to 303%. We must also actively develop hydrogen energy from by-product hydrogen generated in industrial processes like petrochemicals.” (“내년 말 가동 예정인 AI 데이터센터 인근에는 SK멀티유틸리티의 액화천연가스(LNG) 열병합발전소가 있어 전력 수급이 원활하다. 새울 3·4호기 원전이 각각 올해 말과 내년에 가동되면 전력 자급률은 238%가 된다. 노르웨이 등 4국 기업과 해상 풍력 발전을 짓는 방안도 추진 중이다. 이게 잘된다면 전력 자급률은 303%까지 오른다. 석유화학 등 산업 공정에서 나오는 부생 수소를 활용한 수소 에너지 등도 적극 개발해야 한다.”)

- City-province integration has been a recent topic. Unlike Busan and South Gyeongsang Province, Ulsan is negative about integration. (-시·도 통합이 최근 화두였다. 울산은 부산·경남과 달리 통합에 부정적이다.)

“If the central government only delegates authority over land use rights, local legislative and administrative powers, and taxation rights, then integration is possible. I oppose the current government’s policy of only providing 20 trillion won in financial support without such measures. Ulsan, with its independent industrial base, also doesn’t want its citizens to return to the days when it was part of South Gyeongsang Province’s Ulsan city. The ‘Haeorum Economic Bloc’ alliance of Ulsan, Gyeongju, and Pohang is a better option.” (“중앙 정부가 국토 이용권, 지방 입법·행정권, 조세권 등 권한 이양만 한다면 통합할 수 있다. 이런 조치 없이 20조원 재정 지원만 한다는 현 정부 정책에는 반대다. 독자적인 산업 기반을 가진 울산은 시민이 과거 경남 울산시 시절로 돌아가는 것도 원치 않는다. 울산·경주·포항의 ‘해오름 경제권’ 연대가 낫다.”)

- How do you assess your rivals, Democratic Party’s Kim Sang-wook and Progressive Party’s Kim Jong-hoon? (-경쟁자인 민주당 김상욱·진보당 김종훈 후보를 평가한다면.)

“They are excellent individuals. Compared to those two candidates, I have the advantage of abundant experience and knowledge gained from over 30 years in politics and administration in Ulsan. I’d like to describe it as ‘the wisdom of an old horse.’” (“훌륭한 분들이다. 두 후보에 비해 나는 30여 년간 울산에서 정치·행정을 하며 경험과 지식이 풍부하다는 장점이 있다. 노마지지(老馬之智·늙은 말의 지혜)라고 표현하고 싶다.”)

- The two candidates are discussing a unified candidacy. (-두 후보는 단일화 논의가 진행 중이다.)

“Unification is inevitable. Ulsan mayoral elections have historically been one-on-one races. In opinion polls, our party’s (People Power Party) approval rating in the Busan-Ulsan-South Gyeongsang region is around 30%. I believe this is due to a low response rate from conservatives. The on-the-ground sentiment is different. I think there’s a support base of at least 55% for our party in Ulsan. There’s plenty of chance to win.” (“단일화는 필연적일 것이다. 울산시장 선거는 역대 1 대 1 구도였다. 여론조사 때 부·울·경에서 우리 당(국민의힘) 지지도가 30% 안팎이다. 보수층 응답률이 낮기 때문이라 본다. 현장 체감 여론은 다르다. 울산은 최소 55%대 우리 지지층이 있다고 본다. 충분히 승산이 있다.”)

- Former Mayor Park Maeng-woo has declared his independent candidacy. (-박맹우 전 시장이 무소속 출마를 선언했다.)

“It’s regrettable to see a split among conservatives. However, former Mayor Park has already served three terms as Ulsan mayor and two terms as a Ulsan lawmaker. Many citizens are tired of him, and I believe his support is minimal. I don’t see a need to unify with him.” (“보수 분열의 모습을 보여서 안타깝다. 다만 박 전 시장은 이미 3선 울산시장, 재선 울산 국회의원을 지냈다. 식상해 하는 시민도 적지 않고, 지지도도 미미하다고 본다. 단일화할 필요성은 못 느낀다.”)

- How do you view the People Power Party’s nomination and election strategy so far? (-지금까지 국민의힘의 공천, 선거 전략은 어떻게 보나.)

“This election has made me think we shouldn’t rely on the central party. Citizens are too disappointed. In politics, perception is more important than reality, and Representative Jang Dong-hyuk is perceived as incompetent. His recent schedule in the U.S. has exacerbated that. It’s true that Representative Jang’s regional tour plans are a burden.” (“이번 선거는 중앙당을 믿어서는 안 되겠다는 생각이다. 시민이 너무 실망한다. 국민은 사실보다 인식이 중요한데, 장동혁 대표는 못 한다고 인식이 돼 있다. 지난 방미 일정으로 그게 더 커졌다. 장 대표가 지역 순회 일정을 잡으면 부담되는 건 사실이다.”)

- The People Power Party is struggling even in the Yeongnam region. (-국민의힘이 영남권에서도 고전하고 있다.)

“I want to urge the leadership to unite conservatives. Only by showing unity can a nationwide wave stir. Politically, I’m closer to opposing former leader Han Dong-hoon. Still, I think we should either reinstate Han as a party member and let him compete in the primary for the by-election in Busan’s North Gap district, or the party should not field a candidate there. I’ve also spoken with former leader Han. I told him, ‘We need to show unity and transformation rather than individual play.’” (“보수가 결집하자고 지도부에 촉구하고 싶다. 통합의 모습을 보여야 전국에서 바람이 불 것이다. 나는 정치적으로 한동훈 전 대표의 반대쪽에 가깝다. 그래도 한 전 대표를 복당시켜 당내 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 후보 경선을 치르든지, 당이 무공천을 하든지 해야 한다는 생각이다. 한 전 대표와 통화도 했다. ‘우리가 개인 플레이보다 단합과 변모의 모습을 보여줘야 한다’고 했다.”)

- What do you want to say to Representative Jang Dong-hyuk? (-장동혁 대표에게 하고 싶은 말은.)

“Politics requires not just intellect but also experience and wisdom. Representative Jang seems to have faced little wind in the field. Perhaps due to his short political career, his perspective is narrow. Even if he says, ‘I absolutely cannot accept this,’ he must learn to tolerate others embracing (his political rivals) and moving forward.” (“정치는 머리도 있지만, 경험·경륜이 있어야 된다. 장 대표는 들판에 바람을 적게 맞은 것 같다. 정치 경력이 짧아서 그런지 보는 시각이 좁다. ‘나는 도저히 용납이 안 된다’고 하더라도, 다른 사람이 (자신의 정적을) 안고 가는 것은 묵인할 줄 알아야 한다.”)

- What are your future plans? (-향후 계획은.)

“I will announce my candidacy on the 29th. Personally, I think it’s fine to form a Yeongnam region election committee. What do you think about broadly inviting even those who can offer candid advice and showing the face of conservative unity?” (“29일에 출마 선언을 한다. 개인적인 생각은 영남권 선대위를 구성해도 좋을 것 같다. 고언을 해줄 수 있는 분들까지 폭넓게 모시고 보수 통합의 모습을 보여주면 어떨까 한다.”)

☞Who is Kim Doo-gyeom (☞김두겸은 누구)

Born in Ulsan, he graduated from Ulsan Hakseong Middle School, Seoul Gwangsung High School, and Kyungnam University’s Chemistry Department. He was elected as a councilor in the former Ulsan city of South Gyeongsang Province in 1995, the first year of local autonomy. After Ulsan was elevated to a metropolitan city in 1997, he was elected twice each as a Ulsan Nam-gu councilor and as Ulsan Nam-gu district head. In the 2022 local elections, he defeated Democratic Party candidate Song Cheol-ho to become Ulsan mayor. (울산 출신으로 울산 학성중, 서울 광성고, 경남대 화학과를 졸업했다. 지방자치 원년인 1995년 경남 울산시의원에 당선됐다. 1997년 울산이 광역시로 승격한 후 울산 남구의원, 울산 남구청장에 각각 두차례씩 당선됐다. 2022년 지방선거에서 더불어민주당 송철호 후보를 꺾고 울산시장이 됐다.)

item.title: Kim Young-hwan, Chungbuk Governor, Confirmed as People Power Party Candidate (김영환 충북지사, 국민의힘 후보로 확정)
item.description:
Kim Young-hwan, Chungbuk Governor, Confirmed as People Power Party Candidate (김영환 충북지사, 국민의힘 후보로 확정)

Kim Young-hwan, the current governor of Chungcheongbuk-do, was confirmed as the People Power Party candidate for governor on the 27th. Initially excluded through a cut-off (disqualification from nomination), Kim had the suspension of effect granted by the court and proceeded to a primary, securing the candidacy. Seeking reelection, Governor Kim will face Shin Yong-han, the Democratic Party candidate and former deputy chair of the Lee Jae-myung administration's Presidential Committee for Local Development. (국민의힘 충북지사 후보로 김영환 현 충북지사가 27일 확정됐다. 김 지사는 애초 컷오프(공천 배제)됐지만 법원에서 효력 정지 가처분이 인용되면서 경선을 치러 후보로 확정됐다. 재선에 도전하는 김 지사는 이재명 정부 지방시대위원회 부위원장 출신인 신용한 더불어민주당 후보와 맞붙는다.)

The People Power Party announced on the same day that, following the primary results, Governor Kim defeated lawyer Yoon Gap-geun to be selected as the final candidate. The runoff between Governor Kim and Attorney Yoon was held on the 25th and 26th, combining 50% from party member voting and 50% from a general public opinion poll. (국민의힘은 이날 경선 결과 김 지사가 윤갑근 변호사를 꺾고 최종 후보로 선출됐다고 밝혔다. 김 지사와 윤 변호사 간 결선 투표는 지난 25~26일 책임당원 투표 50%와 일반 국민 여론조사 50%를 합산하는 방식으로 치러졌다.)

Immediately after being confirmed as the candidate, Governor Kim stated, "We are one under the name of the People Power Party. Now is the time for us to join forces for the true development of Chungbuk." (김 지사는 후보 확정 직후 “우리는 국민의힘이라는 이름 아래 하나다. 충북의 진정한 발전을 위해 이제 모두 힘을 합쳐야 할 때”라고 했다.)

Candidate Shin Yong-han, who will face Governor Kim, previously beat out Democratic Party heavyweight and former Cheong Wa Dae chief of staff Noh Young-min, among others, to secure his candidacy. Candidate Shin is a figure recruited by President Lee Jae-myung, who was then the Democratic Party leader, ahead of the 2024 general election. Under the Park Geun-hye administration, he served as chairman of the Presidential Committee on Youth; during the 2020 presidential election, he worked for former President Yoon Suk-yeol's campaign before exposing the 'Myung Tae-kyun report' and being designated as a Democratic Party public interest whistleblower. (김 지사와 맞붙는 신용한 후보는 앞서 민주당 중진인 노영민 전 청와대 비서실장 등을 꺾고 후보로 확정됐다. 신 후보는 2024년 총선을 앞두고 당시 민주당 대표였던 이재명 대통령이 영입한 인사다. 박근혜 정부에선 대통령직속 청년위원회 위원장을 지냈고 2020년 대선 땐 윤석열 전 대통령 캠프에서 활동했다가 ‘명태균 보고서’를 폭로해 민주당 공익 제보자로 지정됐었다.)

item.title: Democratic Party Excludes Kim Yong, Aide to Lee Jae-myung, from Candidacy... Lee Gwang-jae in Hanam-gap, Kim Nam-guk in Ansan-gap (민주당, 李 측근 김용 공천 배제… 하남갑 이광재·안산갑 김남국)
item.description:
Democratic Party Excludes Kim Yong, Aide to Lee Jae-myung, from Candidacy... Lee Gwang-jae in Hanam-gap, Kim Nam-guk in Ansan-gap (민주당, 李 측근 김용 공천 배제… 하남갑 이광재·안산갑 김남국)

On the 27th, the Democratic Party of Korea strategically nominated former Gangwon Governor Lee Gwang-jae for the by-election in Gyeonggi Hanam-gap, former Saenuri Party lawmaker Kim Yong-nam for Pyeongtaek-eul, and party spokesperson Kim Nam-guk for Ansan-gap, all to be held concurrently with the June 3 local elections. Kim Yong, the former deputy director of the Democratic Research Institute and a close aide to President Lee Jae-myung awaiting a Supreme Court ruling, was not nominated. (더불어민주당이 27일 6·3 지방선거와 동시에 치러지는 경기 하남갑 보궐선거에 이광재 전 강원지사를, 평택을에 김용남 전 새누리당 의원을, 안산갑에 김남국 당 대변인을 각각 전략 공천했다. 이재명 대통령의 최측근으로 대법원 판결을 앞두고 있는 김용 전 민주연구원 부원장은 공천을 받지 못했다.)

Hanam-gap, where former Governor Lee Gwang-jae is placed, is considered a tough district for the Democratic Party. In the last general election, lawmaker Choo Mi-ae won against the People Power Party candidate by a margin of 1 percentage point. A Democratic Party official stated, "Former Governor Lee is a heavyweight politician who served as a three-term lawmaker and Gangwon Governor, making him a candidate poised for a landslide victory." The People Power Party's candidate for this district has yet to be decided. (이광재 전 지사가 배치된 하남갑은 민주당 험지로 꼽힌다. 지난 총선 때 추미애 의원이 국민의힘 후보에게 1%포인트 차이로 이긴 곳이다. 민주당 관계자는 “이 전 지사는 3선 국회의원과 강원지사를 지낸 중량감 있는 정치인으로 압승할 후보”라고 했다. 이 지역 국민의힘 후보는 아직 정해지지 않았다.)

The election in Pyeongtaek-eul, where former lawmaker Kim Yong-nam is placed, will unfold as a five-way race involving former People Power Party lawmaker Yoo Ui-dong, Cho Kuk (leader of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party), Kim Jae-yeon (leader of the Progressive Party), and Hwang Kyo-ahn (leader of the Freedom and Innovation Party). Former lawmaker Kim, a former prosecutor who moved from the Saenuri Party to the Reform Party and then to the Democratic Party after supporting President Lee Jae-myung in the last presidential election, had been a vocal critic of Cho Kuk during the "Cho Kuk incident," even being called a "Cho Kuk sniper." An opposition source noted, "The Democratic Party's nomination of Kim clearly signals that there will be no candidate unification," but added, "Whether unification happens or not remains uncertain until the final stages of the election." (김용남 전 의원이 배치된 평택을 선거는 유의동 전 국민의힘 의원, 조국 조국혁신당 대표, 김재연 진보당 대표, 황교안 자유와혁신 대표 등 5자 구도로 치러지게 됐다. 김 전 의원은 검사 출신으로 새누리당, 개혁신당 등을 거쳐 지난 대선 때 이재명 대통령을 지지하며 민주당에 입당했다. ‘조국 사태’ 당시 ‘조국 저격수’로 불릴 정도로 조 대표를 강하게 비판했었다. 여권 관계자는 “민주당이 김 전 의원을 공천한 건 ‘후보 단일화는 없다’는 걸 확실히 한 것”이라면서도 “하지만 단일화를 할지 말지는 선거 막판까지 모를 일”이라고 했다.)

Spokesperson Kim Nam-guk, whose candidacy for the strong Democratic-leaning Ansan-gap was confirmed, was elected in the neighboring district of Danwon during the 21st general election but did not run in the 22nd due to allegations of failing to disclose his cryptocurrency assets. After being acquitted, he served as a presidential secretary at the Blue House, stepped down amid the "older sister in the region" text message controversy, and has since served as the party's spokesperson. The People Power Party has nominated former Ansan City Council Chairman Kim Seok-hoon as its candidate for this district. (민주당 지지세가 강한 안산갑에 공천이 확정된 김남국 대변인은 21대 총선 때 옆 지역구인 단원을에서 당선됐다가, ‘코인 재산 신고 누락’ 의혹으로 22대 총선에 불출마했다. 이후 무죄 판결을 받았고 청와대 비서관을 지내다 ‘현지 누나’ 문자 파동으로 그만둔 뒤 당 대변인을 맡아왔다. 국민의힘은 이 지역 후보로 김석훈 전 안산시의장을 공천했다.)

The Democratic Party decided to exclude former Deputy Director Kim Yong, who is on bail after receiving a five-year prison sentence in the second trial for charges of receiving illegal political funds. Over 70 of the Democratic Party's 160 lawmakers had called for Kim's nomination. However, Secretary-General Cho Seung-rae stated, "We judged that considering the overall impact on the election, it is appropriate not to nominate him. It is also difficult to nominate him in any other district." (민주당은 불법 정치자금 수수 혐의로 2심에서 징역 5년형을 받고 보석 중인 김용 전 부원장에 대해선 공천 배제를 결정했다. 민주당 160명 중 70명 넘는 의원이 김 전 부원장 공천을 요구한 바 있다. 하지만 조승래 사무총장은 “선거에 미치는 영향을 종합적으로 판단해서 공천하지 않는 것이 적절하다고 판단했다”면서 “다른 지역 공천도 어렵다”고 했다.)
